selection_order.interpretation: The executable rule applies ZCAT_PRIMARY/ZWARN predicates before deterministic deduplication within the strict cohort. For these exact checkpoint rows, every parent match already has a unique cluster_id and TARGETID, so even the deliberately unsafe order loses zero valid rows; this empirical equality does not redefine the declared safe order.
